utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m glad you reminded me; what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Just some sturdy gloves and a flashlight, if you have them. That’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ve got gloves, and I can grab a flashlight too. I’ll bring them by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No big changes—just tell folks we’re still collecting repair items this week, and I’ll keep repeating the details around the block.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll tell people we’re still collecting repair items this week. Thanks for keeping the details going around the block.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you set the repair drive date yet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not yet — I’m still lining up a few details, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have a date.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — just keep me posted when it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling folks about it now—come by if you can, and bring a friend!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll stop by and spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Opal—thank you! I’ll keep passing it along, and I hope we get a good crowd.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help—what details do we have so far about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I don’t have the details yet, but I can help gather them. Let’s check what still needs fixing and who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Leo — could you bring a screwdriver set and a few spare batteries? I’ll handle the sign-up sheet and the extra extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and some spare batteries.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Bo — I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive organized. What’s the first thing you want to tackle?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s start with the biggest repairs and make a quick list of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a solid start. I’ll jot down the biggest repairs first, and then we can sort the list by urgency.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s bringing what for the repair drive. Can we go over the logistics once more?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — let’s keep it simple and go step by step. If you want, we can make a quick list of who’s bringing each item and what time we’re meeting.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please — let’s do that so nothing gets missed. I’m especially worried about the meeting time and the heavy items.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely—I'm happy to grab a few supplies while I'm out. Just let me know what you still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira—I've only heard bits and pieces, so I’m not totally sure what’s still needed. If you see any tape, gloves, or basic tools, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can do that—I'll keep an eye out for tape, gloves, and any basic tools while I'm running errands. If I find anything else useful, I’ll bring it by too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have for the repair drive and make a quick list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure you can check that today? That’d help us know what’s still missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — I can check today and send you a quick list of what we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over the tools I’ve got. What does the repair drive need first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can start with the basics — hammer, screwdriver set, tape measure, and a drill if you need it. Just tell me where to drop them off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I just need to work around the school pickup time, so I can help after that.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that works — I’ll keep it after pickup and let you know the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Tess. Just send me the exact time when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details over right away, so you can coordinate around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — send them over when you can and I’ll work it around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Hana? Did you get enough volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the numbers first so I don’t give you the wrong answer. I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm how many volunteers we have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—just let me know when you’ve confirmed the count. If you need more hands, I can help ask around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still happening today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thank you — I’ll keep an eye on what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll put together a supplies list and share the updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I’ll need to keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That works—low-key is perfect. Just let me know what time you can swing by.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by around 6, after things calm down a bit.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think it’s still moving along, but I’ve only heard a little. I can check in and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that — I’m only getting second-hand bits too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, probably just a heads-up if anything changes. I might’ve missed a few details, so remind me what’s already set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’ve got the repair drive on the calendar, and I’m just waiting on any updates from you. If anything shifts, I’ll give you a quick heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara — could you help sort donations and keep an eye on the sign-in table? That would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can sort donations and keep an eye on the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Gus, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—come by if you can and bring anyone who might want to help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Count me in, Quinn — I’ll swing by and I can bring my tool kit too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Gus — thanks! Your tool kit will be a huge help, and feel free to bring anyone else who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I heard it’s about the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks for checking in, Dane—could you drop the repair supplies off at the community center by 4? If that doesn’t work, just let me know where you’ll be and I’ll adjust.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yep, I can drop them off at the community center by 4.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that—just let me know if you hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Awesome, Gus — thank you. First up, we’re sorting by tools and checking what’s missing, then we can match each repair to a set.
